title: TiVo "Advanced Paid Program" Snippet
summary: A short clip of a TiVo paid-programming broadcast from the early 2000s, which TiVo used to send guide data and service updates to DVRs over cable TV before broadband was common.
why: Commenters cite it as a concrete example of distributing data over TV broadcasts in discussions of unusual data channels.

quote.text: They would buy a 30 minute paid programming in the early hours on cable TV networks
